items.title: Fusion startup Helion is developing new semiconductors that could double output of its power plants
items.summary: Helion now has another $225 million to help speed development of its first fusion power plant, due to provide Microsoft with electricity in 2028.
items.creator: Tim De Chant

items.title: Developer platform Railway urges ‘all users’ to revoke secret keys after cyberattack
items.summary: The vibe-coding platform said all of its customers should revoke and rotate their private keys, after hackers were able to decrypt some customer secrets.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker
